name: ci_cio_hardening_fast_shards_20261022
comment: ANCHOR: CI_CIO_HARDENING_FAST_SHARDS_20261022 — cio-hardening (27-39 min on push, 28-38 min on release PRs,
2026-10-23) runs as parallel jobs on every event on the cio-full-suite-sharded pattern: 8 shards + serial + pg +
integrity rails; the required context cio-hardening is the aggregate (every job success + --verify-shards: each
registered file exactly once), runs on cancelled/timed-out shards on push so main-red-alert still fires; drafts
run nothing; per-SHA concurrency and alerting unchanged.
